environment.description: AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (REST API) with default configuration. Lambda function URL is publicly accessible. API Gateway has no custom authorizers beyond the session cookie check in code. CORS is configured with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. No WAF attached. The frontend CDN scripts (form-validator.js, csrf-protection.js) provide client-side CSRF token generation but the server-side handler never validates the csrf_token field. SameSite cookie attribute is not set (defaults to None in older browsers).
